name: makable-shorts
description: Makes 1-minute demo videos of your own web product for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels: Claude records the feature in Chrome, writes the script, and the pipeline films you as an AI avatar from your photo and narrates it in your avatar's voice, or makes a product demo with title cards, narrated by a free voice on your machine or with captions alone. And animated explainer Shorts about a topic: Claude writes the storyboard, draws consistent characters and every shot as a still for you to approve, then Gemini Omni animates them and the pipeline narrates them in your voice. Once it's posted, it fetches the video's YouTube and Instagram numbers, works out where viewers left and why, and keeps the lessons for the next script.
